content.name: Grainne Dwyer
profile: Experienced office manager and executive assistant with twelve years supporting directors in professional services and the not-for-profit sector. Highly organised, discreet and responsibile for everything from board packs to the office lease.

experience.title: Office Manager and Executive Assistant to the CEO
bullets: Ran the charity's head office of fifteen staff, from the phone system and the lease to onboarding new starters.
Prepared board packs for six meetings a year and took the minutes for the board and its finance subcommittee.
Organised the annual fundraising gala for four hundred guests, coming in under budget three years running.
Maintained the donor database in Salesforce and produced the monthly income report for the finance manager.

experience.title: Executive Assistant
bullets: Supported two partners with diaries, travel, billing and client correspondence in a busy commercial practice.
Coordinated the move of forty staff to new offices with no lost working days.

experience.title: Receptionist and Administrator
bullets: Front desk, appointment scheduling and patient records for a four-chair practice.
Took over the practice's bookkeeping when the part-time bookkeeper retired.

certifications: Certificate in Bookkeeping and Payroll (Accounting Technicians Ireland)
additional: Interests: gardening, sea swimming, amateur dramatics
